source.tu_vi_dau_so_toan_thu: Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu (Complete Book of Zi Wei Dou Shu, traditionally attributed to Chen Tuan)
source.tuvi_vn: Vietnamese Southern-school framework of Zi Wei Dou Shu

Mệnh.y_nghia: The root palace of the chart: your temperament, your natural reactions, your strengths and the places you tend to trip.
Mệnh.xem_duoc: your personality, how you make decisions, your main energy
Mệnh.khong_tra_loi: does not tell you how rich you will be or how long you will live
Mệnh.cau_tu_soi: Under pressure, what is your first reaction — and does it help you or hold you back?

Huynh Đệ.y_nghia: Relationships between equals: siblings, close friends, partners on the same level.
Huynh Đệ.xem_duoc: how you cooperate and share with people on your level
Huynh Đệ.khong_tra_loi: cannot say what will happen to your siblings
Huynh Đệ.cau_tu_soi: With siblings and friends, are you usually the one who gives or the one who receives?

Phu Thê.y_nghia: What you expect and how you behave in a couple or a marriage.
Phu Thê.xem_duoc: what you look for in a partner and where you tend to clash
Phu Thê.khong_tra_loi: cannot say whether the other person is good or bad, and does not pronounce 'clashing fates' or how many times you will marry
Phu Thê.cau_tu_soi: What you hope your partner will do for you — have you told them clearly?

Tử Nữ.y_nghia: Your relationship with children, the next generation and students; also your own creativity.
Tử Nữ.xem_duoc: how you parent and how you nurture what you create
Tử Nữ.khong_tra_loi: does not tell you how many children you will have, their sex or their health
Tử Nữ.cau_tu_soi: What do you want to pass on to the next generation — through words or through how you live?

Tài Bạch.y_nghia: How you earn, keep and spend money; your attitude to material things.
Tài Bạch.xem_duoc: the kind of income that suits your temperament, spending habits that drain you
Tài Bạch.khong_tra_loi: gives no income figure and does not pick an investment for you
Tài Bạch.cau_tu_soi: Does your money usually go on real needs or on feelings?

Tật Ách.y_nghia: How your body and mind react to pressure, and where you tend to store tension.
Tật Ách.xem_duoc: your rhythm of rest and the self-care habits worth watching
Tật Ách.khong_tra_loi: does not diagnose illness or predict accidents — health needs a doctor
Tật Ách.cau_tu_soi: Which sign of tiredness does your body give that you tend to ignore?

Thiên Di.y_nghia: You out in the world, travelling, meeting strangers; the image other people see in you.
Thiên Di.xem_duoc: how you adapt to new surroundings and the openings that come with moving
Thiên Di.khong_tra_loi: cannot say whether any particular trip is safe or dangerous
Thiên Di.cau_tu_soi: In an unfamiliar place, are you more open or more guarded than at home?

Nô Bộc.y_nghia: Acquaintances, colleagues, people who work for you, customers — the network around you.
Nô Bộc.xem_duoc: the kind of people you attract and how you keep boundaries
Nô Bộc.khong_tra_loi: does not conclude that anyone will betray you or stay loyal
Nô Bộc.cau_tu_soi: Do you choose friends for comfort or for shared values?

Quan Lộc.y_nghia: How you work, the settings and roles that suit you, and how you pursue achievement.
Quan Lộc.xem_duoc: your working style and the kinds of work that suit your temperament
Quan Lộc.khong_tra_loi: does not name one single career and does not promise promotion
Quan Lộc.cau_tu_soi: Which work makes you lose track of time — and what does it have in common with what you do now?

Điền Trạch.y_nghia: Your home, the places you live, fixed assets and the atmosphere of the household.
Điền Trạch.xem_duoc: your need for a settled home and how you build up assets
Điền Trạch.khong_tra_loi: does not pick the year to buy a house or a particular house for you
Điền Trạch.cau_tu_soi: For you, is 'home' a place or the people in it?

Phúc Đức.y_nghia: Your spiritual base, inner life, deep joys, family line and inherited blessings; Vietnamese Zi Wei gives this palace great weight.
Phúc Đức.xem_duoc: what feeds your spirit and how you find peace
Phúc Đức.khong_tra_loi: cannot measure 'how much blessing' you have in numbers
Phúc Đức.cau_tu_soi: What lightens your heart even when no one praises you for it?

Phụ Mẫu.y_nghia: Your relationship with parents, elders and bosses; also paperwork and your basic education.
Phụ Mẫu.xem_duoc: how you take in teaching and how you deal with people in authority
Phụ Mẫu.khong_tra_loi: cannot say anything about your parents' health or lifespan
Phụ Mẫu.cau_tu_soi: What from your parents do you want to keep, and what do you want to do differently?

Tử Vi.tinh_chat: The Emperor star: self-respecting, wants to lead, likes order and being respected.
Tử Vi.diem_manh: stepping up to carry the load, organising, upholding standards
Tử Vi.mat_toi: can feel lonely at the top, worries about face, finds feedback hard to take
Tử Vi.bieu_hien: often takes over the decision when the group is stuck
Tử Vi.khi_sang: Bright: natural dignity that earns respect; knows how to use people well and carry big tasks while keeping a sense of measure — the 'king' quality in the right place.
Tử Vi.khi_ham: Dim: wants to be in charge without the backing, protective of face, talks bigger than their strength; needs good helpers (Zuo Fu and You Bi, Tian Kui and Tian Yue) to stand firm.
Tử Vi.cau_tu_soi: Do you let others see when you need help?

Thiên Cơ.tinh_chat: The Strategist star: quick-witted, loves to think things through, often switches plans.
Thiên Cơ.mat_toi: thinks a lot and does little, worries ahead, wavers easily
Thiên Cơ.bieu_hien: usually has plan B and plan C ready before starting
Thiên Cơ.khi_sang: Bright: quick-witted, plans at the right moment, good at planning and improvising; trusted as an adviser.
Thiên Cơ.khi_ham: Fallen: thinking goes in circles, worries ahead, changes mind unpredictably; many small schemes but few finished — needs to settle on one direction and see it through.
Thiên Cơ.cau_tu_soi: Which plan have you thought through carefully but not yet started?

Thái Dương.tinh_chat: The Noble star: generous, outgoing, likes to give and to be seen by others.
Thái Dương.diem_manh: inspiring others, generous, open and transparent
Thái Dương.mat_toi: cares for others beyond their own strength, burns out easily, hungry for recognition
Thái Dương.bieu_hien: often takes on helping others before their own tasks
Thái Dương.khi_sang: Bright: the daytime sun — generous, warm, well regarded, does visible work that gets noticed; likes to help.
Thái Dương.khi_ham: Fallen: the sun at night — looks after others but is rarely acknowledged, works hard and tires easily; better suited to quiet, specialist work than chasing a name.
Thái Dương.cau_tu_soi: Are you giving more than you can keep up?

Vũ Khúc.tinh_chat: The Wealth star: decisive, practical, good at managing money and resources.
Vũ Khúc.diem_manh: disciplined, follows through, fair and square
Vũ Khúc.mat_toi: rigid, dry in matters of the heart, solitary
Vũ Khúc.bieu_hien: usually weighs cost and results before talking about feelings
Vũ Khúc.khi_sang: Bright: the wealth star well placed — decisive, good with money, practical in business, able to build wealth on their own.
Vũ Khúc.khi_ham: Fallen: rigid, solitary, money comes and goes; clashes easily through blunt speech — needs more softness with people and discipline with spending.
Vũ Khúc.cau_tu_soi: Do the people close to you feel your care, or only your worrying?

Thiên Đồng.tinh_chat: The Blessing star: mild, easy-going, enjoys comfort and harmony.
Thiên Đồng.mat_toi: avoids hard things, procrastinates, lacks drive
Thiên Đồng.bieu_hien: is often the one who makes the group's mood easier
Thiên Đồng.khi_sang: Bright: a gentle blessing star, optimistic and easy to get along with; enjoys small joys and usually finds help in hard times.
Thiên Đồng.khi_ham: Fallen: likes ease and avoids effort, drifts with circumstances; many shifts in youth — needs to set their own goals.
Thiên Đồng.cau_tu_soi: Which hard task are you leaving for 'later'?

Liêm Trinh.tinh_chat: The Prisoner star: principled, strong emotions, magnetic and ambitious.
Liêm Trinh.diem_manh: upright once convinced, persistent, able to organise
Liêm Trinh.mat_toi: hot-tempered, stubborn, easily caught up in gossip and disputes
Liêm Trinh.bieu_hien: often reacts strongly to anything that breaks a principle
Liêm Trinh.khi_sang: Bright: serious, principled, precise; gifted in work that needs discipline (administration, engineering, legal and compliance work).
Liêm Trinh.khi_ham: Fallen: quick temper, easily offended, prone to gossip or clashes; should avoid shortcuts and keep a calm mind.
Liêm Trinh.cau_tu_soi: Which of your principles is helping you, and which is tying you down?

Thiên Phủ.tinh_chat: The Treasury star: steady, careful, good at keeping and saving.
Thiên Phủ.mat_toi: conservative, avoids risk, wants too much safety
Thiên Phủ.bieu_hien: usually keeps a reserve before trying anything new
Thiên Phủ.khi_sang: Bright: a full treasury — calm, careful with things, good at saving and managing; trusted to look after money and people.
Thiên Phủ.khi_ham: Dim: a half-empty treasury — overly cautious, fears running short, conservative; needs to be bolder when opportunities come.
Thiên Phủ.cau_tu_soi: Which safety net are you holding on to that you no longer need?

Thái Âm.tinh_chat: The Riches star: refined, sensitive, inward-looking, likes to build up quietly.
Thái Âm.diem_manh: thoughtful, a good eye for beauty, patient
Thái Âm.mat_toi: very emotional, keeps things inside, can feel sad for no clear reason
Thái Âm.bieu_hien: often notices small changes in other people's moods
Thái Âm.khi_sang: Bright: a full autumn moon — gentle, refined, rich in feeling and taste; a knack for quietly building up property and savings.
Thái Âm.khi_ham: Fallen: the moon by day — moods swing, often sad or suspicious; can lose out in love or money by trusting too easily.
Thái Âm.cau_tu_soi: Does what you are holding inside need to be said out loud?

Tham Lang.tinh_chat: The Romance star: hungry for life, many talents, good at socialising, many desires.
Tham Lang.diem_manh: flexible, attractive, quick to learn many things
Tham Lang.mat_toi: eager at first then quickly bored, easily lost in pleasure
Tham Lang.bieu_hien: often has several hobbies at once
Tham Lang.khi_sang: Bright: many talents, wide connections, keen to learn and enjoys life in moderation; resourceful and lucky in business.
Tham Lang.khi_ham: Fallen: desires that are hard to stop, easily drawn into partying, gambling and tangled relationships; needs clear limits.
Tham Lang.cau_tu_soi: Of all the things you want, which do you really need?

Cự Môn.tinh_chat: The Dark star: sharp, a good talker, questions and analyses everything to the end.
Cự Môn.diem_manh: arguing a case, critical thinking, work that uses words
Cự Môn.mat_toi: suspicious, words can stir up disputes, slow to trust people
Cự Môn.khi_sang: Bright: words that carry weight — good at reasoning and analysis, suited to work with words (teaching, law, consulting, media).
Cự Môn.khi_ham: Fallen: words that stir up trouble, easily misunderstood or giving offence; often suspicious — better to say less and check more.
Cự Môn.cau_tu_soi: What was the last thing you said that you regretted?

Thiên Tướng.tinh_chat: The Seal star: fair, values courtesy, good at supporting and coordinating.
Thiên Tướng.diem_manh: reliable, knows how to save face for others
Thiên Tướng.mat_toi: easily swayed, lacks a firm view when standing alone
Thiên Tướng.bieu_hien: often steps in to settle things when two sides disagree
Thiên Tướng.khi_sang: Bright: upright, keeps their word, stands up for what is right; trustworthy in managing and coordinating roles.
Thiên Tướng.khi_ham: Fallen: easily pulled along by others and dragged into their trouble; likes appearances — needs to choose the right people to help.
Thiên Tướng.cau_tu_soi: Are you living by your own standards or by someone else's?

Thiên Lương.tinh_chat: The Shelter star: protective, likes to guide, values doing what is right.
Thiên Lương.diem_manh: protecting, advising, calm in a crisis
Thiên Lương.mat_toi: prone to lecturing, solitary, likes to play the 'rescuer'
Thiên Lương.bieu_hien: others often come to them for advice
Thiên Lương.khi_sang: Bright: the 'teacher' star, a shelter — decent, kind-hearted, helps others; tends to get through trouble and is well respected.
Thiên Lương.khi_ham: Fallen: likes to lecture and meddle in others' affairs; can become lonely or rootless — better to help when asked.
Thiên Lương.cau_tu_soi: Do you let other people learn their own lessons?

Thất Sát.tinh_chat: The General star: brave, independent, ready to push forward and make changes.
Thất Sát.diem_manh: decisive, handles pressure well, opens new paths
Thất Sát.mat_toi: hasty, reckless, finds long-term cooperation hard
Thất Sát.bieu_hien: often chooses to act now rather than wait for full information
Thất Sát.khi_sang: Bright: a general going into battle — bold, determined, takes on hard work; can rise fast at times thanks to sheer grit.
Thất Sát.khi_ham: Fallen: hasty and reckless, a life of ups and downs; trips through hurry — needs patience and steady, sure steps.
Thất Sát.cau_tu_soi: The last time you acted too fast, what did you learn?

Phá Quân.tinh_chat: The Consumer star: breaks the old to build the new, loves reform, won't be boxed in.
Phá Quân.diem_manh: dares to change, innovates, starts ventures
Phá Quân.bieu_hien: often wants to start over when the old way isn't working
Phá Quân.khi_sang: Bright: a trailblazer — dares to break the old to make the new, strong bounce-back, suited to start-ups and restructuring.
Phá Quân.khi_ham: Fallen: tears down more than it builds, often leaves things unfinished, money leaks; home and work can be unsettled — needs a foundation that holds them steady.
Phá Quân.cau_tu_soi: What do you want to break down — and what do you want to build in its place?

Tử Vi.Mệnh: Strong self-respect, wants to run their own life; suited to leading roles but needs to learn to listen.
Tử Vi.Huynh Đệ: Siblings or close friends often have strong personalities; things go well when each respects the other's place.
Tử Vi.Phu Thê: Expects a partner with standing and backbone; clashes come when both want to make the call.
Tử Vi.Tử Nữ: High hopes for the children; needs to avoid pressing their own mould onto them.
Tử Vi.Tài Bạch: Money comes through position and reputation rather than luck; spending to keep up appearances is where it leaks.
Tử Vi.Tật Ách: Stress tends to build from carrying responsibility alone; share the load and rest at the right time.
Tử Vi.Thiên Di: Out in the world they are respected and meet helpful people; new settings often open a bigger role.
Tử Vi.Nô Bộc: The network includes people of standing; needs to tell real helpers from those who lean on them.
Tử Vi.Quan Lộc: Suited to management and leadership in a clearly structured place; uncomfortable when treated as a subordinate.
Tử Vi.Điền Trạch: Sees the home as a mark of standing; usually wants a proper, settled place to live.
Tử Vi.Phúc Đức: The inner self needs respect and meaning; peace comes from work of lasting value.
Tử Vi.Phụ Mẫu: Relations with parents and bosses lean towards rules and protocol; learns a lot from people of standing.

Thiên Cơ.Mệnh: Quick-witted, full of ideas, loves to think things through; the skill to build is reaching a decision and sticking to it.
Thiên Cơ.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and friends often swap ideas; bonds form through conversation more than long joint projects.
Thiên Cơ.Phu Thê: Expects a clever, understanding partner; trouble comes from overthinking and guessing each other's minds.
Thiên Cơ.Tử Nữ: Cares about teaching the children to think; the children may be sharp and full of questions.
Thiên Cơ.Tài Bạch: Money comes from brainwork, advice and planning; income tends to shift from one stage to the next.
Thiên Cơ.Tật Ách: Stress easily comes from thinking too much; sleep and a steady rest rhythm are the things to protect.
Thiên Cơ.Thiên Di: Likes moving around and learning from new places; often changes jobs or homes.
Thiên Cơ.Nô Bộc: Varied, clever friends who come and go; few relationships last very long.
Thiên Cơ.Quan Lộc: Suited to planning, analysis, technical and advisory work; needs a place with room for new ideas.
Thiên Cơ.Điền Trạch: May move house a few times; likes a practical, well-thought-out home.
Thiên Cơ.Phúc Đức: A restless mind that finds stillness hard; peace comes from learning and understanding something new.
Thiên Cơ.Phụ Mẫu: Parents and bosses are often tactful people; you learn how to think things through from them.

Thái Dương.Mệnh: Outgoing, generous, likes to be recognised; tends to take on other people's work.
Thái Dương.Huynh Đệ: Often the one who looks after siblings and friends; should avoid carrying everything for them.
Thái Dương.Phu Thê: Expects a decent, honourable partner; can get so busy outside that little time is left for home.
Thái Dương.Tử Nữ: Wants to be a role model for the children; the children are often open and like to express themselves.
Thái Dương.Tài Bạch: Money comes through reputation and visible work; being generous, needs discipline to hold on to it.
Thái Dương.Tật Ách: Can burn out from overwork; worth keeping an eye on the eyes and blood pressure as your doctor advises, and resting regularly.
Thái Dương.Thiên Di: Becomes well known out in the world; suited to wide settings with plenty of contact.
Thái Dương.Nô Bộc: A wide network and a habit of helping; needs to be selective so their kindness isn't taken advantage of.
Thái Dương.Quan Lộc: Suited to education, media, public service and work with a sense of contribution.
Thái Dương.Điền Trạch: A bright home that welcomes guests; assets are tied to hard work.
Thái Dương.Phúc Đức: The inner self needs to contribute; peace comes from feeling useful.
Thái Dương.Phụ Mẫu: The father and elders have a big influence; learns a sense of responsibility from them.

Vũ Khúc.Mệnh: Decisive, practical, good with money; needs more softness in relationships.
Vũ Khúc.Huynh Đệ: Fair, clear-cut relations with siblings; distance can grow when money gets involved.
Vũ Khúc.Phu Thê: Expects a practical, capable partner; love can dry up if all the talk is about money.
Vũ Khúc.Tử Nữ: Raises the children with discipline; needs more warmth and listening.
Vũ Khúc.Tài Bạch: The wealth star in a fitting place: good at earning and keeping money, suited to finance and disciplined business.
Vũ Khúc.Tật Ách: Stress is often bottled up inside; better to find ways to release it than just endure.
Vũ Khúc.Thiên Di: Does well doing business outside, suited to competitive settings with clear numbers.
Vũ Khúc.Nô Bộc: Colleagues and staff work by the rules; relationships rest on results.
Vũ Khúc.Quan Lộc: Suited to finance, banking, engineering and management — anywhere decisiveness is needed.
Vũ Khúc.Điền Trạch: Builds up fixed assets according to a plan; sees the home more as an asset than a nest.
Vũ Khúc.Phúc Đức: Rarely shows the inner self; at peace when everything is under control.
Vũ Khúc.Phụ Mẫu: Strict parents and bosses; you learn discipline from them.

Thiên Đồng.Mệnh: Mild, approachable, likes an easy life; needs to build determination for the hard tasks.
Thiên Đồng.Huynh Đệ: Harmonious, pleasant siblings and friends; light relationships with little conflict.
Thiên Đồng.Phu Thê: Expects a smooth, pampering relationship; tends to dodge conflict when it comes.
Thiên Đồng.Tử Nữ: Close to the children and easily plays with them; needs more rules.
Thiên Đồng.Tài Bạch: Money comes steadily but not in floods; enjoying life, tends to spend on pleasures.
Thiên Đồng.Tật Ách: Tires easily from too little exercise or irregular eating; a steady daily rhythm keeps the strength up.
Thiên Đồng.Thiên Di: Well liked when out and about; enjoys outings and light experiences.
Thiên Đồng.Nô Bộc: Lots of cheerful friends; few who really take on big projects together.
Thiên Đồng.Quan Lộc: Suited to service and care work in stable settings without fierce competition.
Thiên Đồng.Điền Trạch: Likes a comfortable, convenient home; doesn't put much weight on big assets.
Thiên Đồng.Phúc Đức: An optimistic inner self that finds small joys; this is an important source of blessing.
Thiên Đồng.Phụ Mẫu: Warm relations with parents, often spoilt; needs to become independent earlier.

Liêm Trinh.Mệnh: Principled, strong emotions, magnetic; needs to keep the temper in check.
Liêm Trinh.Huynh Đệ: Relations with siblings get tense at times because everyone holds their ground; be direct but gentle.
Liêm Trinh.Phu Thê: Intense love that expects total faithfulness; prone to jealousy or tension.
Liêm Trinh.Tử Nữ: Raises the children strictly with high moral standards; should avoid being rigid.
Liêm Trinh.Tài Bạch: Money comes through organising ability; avoid 'quick' money that isn't transparent.
Liêm Trinh.Tật Ách: Stress easily bursts out as anger; find healthy ways to let off pressure.
Liêm Trinh.Thiên Di: Magnetic out in the world but easily caught up in gossip; keep to transparent principles.
Liêm Trinh.Nô Bộc: A complicated network; keep people and tasks clearly separate.
Liêm Trinh.Quan Lộc: Suited to management, legal and compliance, technical work — anywhere discipline and principles matter.
Liêm Trinh.Điền Trạch: Home and property need clear paperwork; be careful with joint ownership.
Liêm Trinh.Phúc Đức: An inner tug-of-war between desire and principle; peace comes from living true to one's values.
Liêm Trinh.Phụ Mẫu: Relations with parents and bosses are tense at times; teaches lessons about principles.

Thiên Phủ.Mệnh: Steady, tolerant, good at looking after things; needs to dare to try something new at the right time.
Thiên Phủ.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and friends can be relied on; lasting, practical relationships.
Thiên Phủ.Phu Thê: Expects a stable family and a thoughtful partner; things can grow dull without renewal.
Thiên Phủ.Tử Nữ: Provides carefully for the children's material needs; worth spending more time talking with them.
Thiên Phủ.Tài Bạch: The treasury star in a fitting place: good at saving and managing assets, careful with spending.
Thiên Phủ.Tật Ách: Stress builds from worrying about keeping everything safe; regular, moderate eating is the thing to watch.
Thiên Phủ.Thiên Di: Trusted out in the world, suited to roles managing resources.
Thiên Phủ.Nô Bộc: A stable network with reliable people; few surface-level ties.
Thiên Phủ.Quan Lộc: Suited to administration, finance and asset management, where stability is needed.
Thiên Phủ.Điền Trạch: Values home and land; builds up property step by step.
Thiên Phủ.Phúc Đức: At peace when there is a solid foundation; the blessing lies in having enough.
Thiên Phủ.Phụ Mẫu: Caring, protective parents and bosses; you inherit their carefulness.

Thái Âm.Mệnh: Refined, sensitive, inward-looking; needs to speak up instead of keeping things inside.
Thái Âm.Huynh Đệ: Bonds with siblings and friends are emotional; quietly takes care of others.
Thái Âm.Phu Thê: Expects a gentle, understanding partner; hurt when not understood.
Thái Âm.Tử Nữ: Close to the children and cares for them in detail; the children are often sensitive.
Thái Âm.Tài Bạch: Money builds up quietly, good at saving; suited to steady income and long-term assets.
Thái Âm.Tật Ách: Emotions strongly affect health; sleep and mood need looking after.
Thái Âm.Thiên Di: Reserved at first when out in the world but liked for being thoughtful.
Thái Âm.Nô Bộc: Few friends but deep ones; many people come to them to confide.
Thái Âm.Quan Lộc: Suited to beauty, care, finance, real estate and detailed work.
Thái Âm.Điền Trạch: Values the home deeply; likes a quiet, cosy home and tends to build up property.
Thái Âm.Phúc Đức: A deep, emotional inner life; peace comes from art and nature.
Thái Âm.Phụ Mẫu: The mother has a big influence; learns thoughtfulness from her.

Tham Lang.Mệnh: Hungry for life, many talents, a good communicator; needs to choose among desires so as not to scatter.
Tham Lang.Huynh Đệ: Fun-loving siblings and friends who like to enjoy life together; keep clear boundaries about money.
Tham Lang.Phu Thê: Passionate love and many admirers; clear commitments help avoid misunderstandings.
Tham Lang.Tử Nữ: Lively children with many interests; parents need to model moderation.
Tham Lang.Tài Bạch: Money comes from networking, business and entertainment; easily spent on pleasure.
Tham Lang.Tật Ách: Prone to overeating and late nights; set a fixed bedtime and cut down on alcohol.
Tham Lang.Thiên Di: Great at socialising out in the world, many openings; stay alert to temptation.
Tham Lang.Nô Bộc: A wide network of social contacts; choose friends wisely to save energy.
Tham Lang.Quan Lộc: Suited to business, sales, entertainment, the arts and diplomacy.
Tham Lang.Điền Trạch: Homes may change; likes beautiful, comfortable spaces.
Tham Lang.Phúc Đức: An inner life full of longings; at peace on finding what they truly love.
Tham Lang.Phụ Mẫu: Open relations with parents, though sometimes lacking deep closeness.

Cự Môn.Mệnh: Sharp, a good talker, analytical; needs to watch their words to avoid disputes.
Cự Môn.Huynh Đệ: Relations with siblings easily turn into arguments; be clear from the start.
Cự Môn.Phu Thê: Words easily cause misunderstandings in a couple; frank conversation keeps things together.
Cự Môn.Tử Nữ: Teaches the children with reasons; the children may argue back, so patience is needed.
Cự Môn.Tài Bạch: Money comes from work using words and expertise; keep paperwork clear in business.
Cự Môn.Tật Ách: Stress often comes from negative thoughts and worry; share with someone you trust.
Cự Môn.Thiên Di: Has to compete with arguments out in the world; suited to debate and negotiation.
Cự Môn.Nô Bộc: Colleagues easily attract gossip; stay transparent to avoid misunderstandings.
Cự Môn.Quan Lộc: Suited to law, education, consulting, media, sales and research.
Cự Môn.Điền Trạch: Home and property can lead to paperwork disputes; get the legal side clear.
Cự Môn.Phúc Đức: A questioning, restless inner self; peace comes on finding a satisfying answer.
Cự Môn.Phụ Mẫu: Relations with parents and bosses need plenty of talking to understand each other.

Thiên Tướng.Mệnh: Fair, values courtesy, good at supporting others; needs to develop a view of their own.
Thiên Tướng.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and friends help each other at the right time; loyal relationships.
Thiên Tướng.Phu Thê: Expects a relationship of mutual respect and fairness; tends to give in too much.
Thiên Tướng.Tử Nữ: Raises the children with good manners; an orderly parent–child relationship.
Thiên Tướng.Tài Bạch: Money comes from stable work and a trusted position; suited to a regular income.
Thiên Tướng.Tật Ách: Stress comes from trying to please everyone; needs to learn to say 'no'.
Thiên Tướng.Thiên Di: Trusted out in the world, often asked for favours.
Thiên Tướng.Nô Bộc: Colleagues and staff are good when rules are clear; you are often the one in the middle sorting things out when two sides disagree.
Thiên Tướng.Quan Lộc: Suited to administration, HR, legal work, coordination and senior assistant roles.
Thiên Tướng.Điền Trạch: A neat, tidy home; likes things in order.
Thiên Tướng.Phúc Đức: The inner self values fairness; at peace when people treat each other kindly.
Thiên Tướng.Phụ Mẫu: Smooth relations with parents and bosses; you are trusted with important tasks.

Thiên Lương.Mệnh: Protective, values doing right, calm; needs to avoid lecturing.
Thiên Lương.Huynh Đệ: Often the one who shelters siblings and friends; relationships rest on loyalty.
Thiên Lương.Phu Thê: Expects a mature partner; may prefer someone older, or be the one who protects the other.
Thiên Lương.Tử Nữ: Wants to teach the children right from wrong; the children are well protected but need room to learn for themselves.
Thiên Lương.Tài Bạch: Money comes steadily, without chasing quick gains; suited to service and insurance work.
Thiên Lương.Tật Ách: Staying calm in difficulty is a strength; regular check-ups as your doctor advises still matter.
Thiên Lương.Thiên Di: Often meets helpers out in the world, or is the helper for others.
Thiên Lương.Nô Bộc: The network treats them as a guide; needs to keep boundaries.
Thiên Lương.Quan Lộc: Suited to healthcare, education, insurance, social work and advisory roles.
Thiên Lương.Điền Trạch: The home is often inherited or tied to the family.
Thiên Lương.Phúc Đức: A steady inner self drawn to ethics and spirituality; this is a source of blessing.
Thiên Lương.Phụ Mẫu: Good relations with parents and elders; often looked after by them.

Thất Sát.Mệnh: Brave, independent, ready to open new paths; needs patience and teamwork.
Thất Sát.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and friends with strong personalities clash easily; respecting each other's space keeps things together.
Thất Sát.Phu Thê: Strong, intense love; both need their own space to avoid head-on clashes.
Thất Sát.Tử Nữ: Independent, strong-willed children; teach through respect rather than force.
Thất Sát.Tài Bạch: Money comes by pushing forward and competing; income rises and falls by stages.
Thất Sát.Tật Ách: Built-up pressure can lead to exhaustion; rest in between each burst of effort.
Thất Sát.Thiên Di: Dares to take risks out in the world, suited to challenging settings.
Thất Sát.Nô Bộc: Strong colleagues; roles need to be clear to avoid power struggles.
Thất Sát.Quan Lộc: Suited to the military, engineering, start-ups and work that needs decisiveness under pressure.
Thất Sát.Điền Trạch: Homes may change a lot; assets come through big efforts.
Thất Sát.Phúc Đức: An inner self that is rarely still; at peace when there is a goal worth pursuing.
Thất Sát.Phụ Mẫu: Relations with parents and bosses are tense at times; likes to decide for themselves.

Phá Quân.Mệnh: Loves change and breaking moulds; needs to learn to finish before starting over.
Phá Quân.Huynh Đệ: Relations with siblings shift, sometimes close, sometimes distant.
Phá Quân.Phu Thê: Love goes through ups and downs and craves constant renewal; commitment needs nurturing.
Phá Quân.Tử Nữ: Independent children who like to be different; parents need to be flexible.
Phá Quân.Tài Bạch: Money flows in and out strongly; keep an emergency fund and avoid impulsive investments.
Phá Quân.Tật Ách: Easily drained by living at high intensity; needs a steady rest rhythm.
Phá Quân.Thiên Di: Ready for change out in the world, suited to new, innovative settings.
Phá Quân.Nô Bộc: The network changes with each stage of life.
Phá Quân.Quan Lộc: Suited to start-ups, restructuring, technology and work that replaces the old with the new.
Phá Quân.Điền Trạch: The home may be renovated or changed many times.
Phá Quân.Phúc Đức: Restless with the old; at peace when able to create.
Phá Quân.Phụ Mẫu: Differences of view with parents and bosses; mutual respect helps.

Lộc.Mệnh: People warm to you and help you easily; openings often come through the way you behave. Keep your small promises so that goodwill lasts.
Lộc.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and close friends often help you find work or business contacts, or lend a hand when needed. Repay them fairly to keep the bond.
Lộc.Phu Thê: Your partner tends to bring advantages: extra income, new contacts, a cheerful home. Say out loud what they have contributed.
Lộc.Tử Nữ: Your children, or what you create (products, students), make you proud and can even become a source of income. Make time for your children while things are going well.
Lộc.Tài Bạch: Money comes fairly easily, often with extras beyond the salary such as bonuses or side work. Put part of every extra aside straight away.
Lộc.Tật Ách: Health is generally fine, but you can overdo eating and lounging when relaxed. Keep meals moderate even when celebrating.
Lộc.Thiên Di: Going out, travelling or changing settings often brings openings: business contacts, new work, helpful people. Take trips with a clear purpose.
Lộc.Nô Bộc: Friends, colleagues and customers bring business and referrals. Stay in touch even when you don't need a favour.
Lộc.Quan Lộc: Work goes fairly smoothly: good assignments, bonuses and recognition come your way. Choose work that fits your strengths instead of taking everything.
Lộc.Điền Trạch: You may gain property, valuable belongings or inherit assets from the family. Get the paperwork clear from the start.
Lộc.Phúc Đức: You know how to find small joys and rarely let sadness drag on; relatives tend to support each other. Set aside a fund for your hobbies so you can enjoy them without worry.
Lộc.Phụ Mẫu: Parents, teachers or bosses are willing to support you; paperwork and studies go fairly smoothly. Ask their advice before big decisions.

Quyền.Mệnh: You like to decide for yourself and often take the lead when the group is stuck. Check with the people involved before deciding for everyone.
Quyền.Huynh Đệ: Among siblings or close friends someone has a strong voice and decides for others — sometimes it is you. Agree clearly who handles which part of shared tasks.
Quyền.Phu Thê: In the relationship one person tends to want to decide everything, from money to housework. Agree who decides what, and talk big things through together.
Quyền.Tử Nữ: You expect a lot and like to plan things for your children; they have strong personalities too. Let them choose things that are within their reach.
Quyền.Tài Bạch: You actively earn money, negotiate well and keep a tight grip on spending. Let your family know the money plan too.
Quyền.Tật Ách: You handle pressure well but tend to push through, working on even when tired. Set a daily stop time and keep to it.
Quyền.Thiên Di: Out in the world you are respected and often put in charge in new places. Listen to the people there before changing how they work.
Quyền.Nô Bộc: You often lead the group and have staff or followers. Delegate clearly and let people choose how to do the work.
Quyền.Quan Lộc: Work comes with management, decision-making and big responsibilities. Learn to delegate so you don't carry it all.
Quyền.Điền Trạch: You are the one who decides about the home and household assets. Talk it over with the family before big purchases or sales.
Quyền.Phúc Đức: You have a strong will and make up your own mind about inner matters; others rarely sway you. Listen to loved ones when you are stuck.
Quyền.Phụ Mẫu: Parents or bosses are strict and commanding and expect a lot from you. Make your case with reasons and figures rather than arguing back.

Khoa.Mệnh: You have a good name, a courteous manner and people believe what you say. Keep your credibility by doing what you promise.
Khoa.Huynh Đệ: Siblings and close friends give you timely advice, helping more with morale than money. Ask their view when you are unsure.
Khoa.Phu Thê: The two of you respect each other and rarely raise your voices; your partner is often educated and well regarded. Keep the habit of saying clearly what you think.
Khoa.Tử Nữ: Your children love learning and easily earn a good name at school or work. Praise the specific things they do well.
Khoa.Tài Bạch: Money comes through reputation, expertise and qualifications rather than luck. Invest in learning to raise your own value.
Khoa.Tật Ách: When you are worn out someone usually looks after you, and good care is easy to find. Keep up regular check-ups.
Khoa.Thiên Di: Out in the world you are trusted and easily build a name in new places. Keep your records and references complete when you move.
Khoa.Nô Bộc: Friends and colleagues are often educated people who introduce you to good contacts. Keep up your professional relationships.
Khoa.Quan Lộc: Work is tied to expertise and qualifications, and you can build a name in your field. Write, teach or share your expertise to become known.
Khoa.Điền Trạch: Home and property papers are usually clear, with few disputes. Keep copies of documents somewhere safe.
Khoa.Phúc Đức: You feel settled when learning, reading and living decently; you rarely hold grudges. Keep a regular reading or learning habit.
Khoa.Phụ Mẫu: Parents or mentors value education and are happy to guide you; exams and paperwork go fairly smoothly. Ask their view when choosing a school or a job.

Kỵ.Mệnh: You tend to make things hard for yourself, going over the same thing again and again and blaming yourself when it isn't done. Write down what is worrying you, then pick one small thing to do right now.
Kỵ.Huynh Đệ: Matters with siblings or close friends easily weigh on you, especially shared money. Keep money separate from affection, and write it down if you lend.
Kỵ.Phu Thê: The two of you easily misunderstand each other over things left unsaid. Set aside one time each week to talk openly, without blame.
Kỵ.Tử Nữ: You worry about your children more than needed and get tense when they don't do things your way. Hear them out before giving your view.
Kỵ.Tài Bạch: Money in and out often snags: unexpected costs, late payments. Keep an emergency fund and track spending every month.
Kỵ.Tật Ách: Stress tends to build up and sleep gets shallow when something is on your mind. Keep a fixed bedtime and have regular check-ups as your doctor advises.
Kỵ.Thiên Di: Going out or travelling can bring small hitches: delays, forgotten documents, changed plans. Prepare a day ahead and leave earlier than planned.
Kỵ.Nô Bộc: Misunderstandings with colleagues or friends come easily, or you help people who then forget it. Make clear who does what, and write money matters down.
Kỵ.Quan Lộc: Work often weighs on your mind: pressure, changes of direction, standards set too high. Settle on one goal per quarter instead of taking on many.
Kỵ.Điền Trạch: Home matters can take a lot of effort: repairs, unclear papers, second thoughts about where to live. Check the paperwork carefully before paying.
Kỵ.Phúc Đức: Your mind finds it hard to rest and often worries about relatives or the past. Have one activity that truly rests your mind, like walking or gardening.
Kỵ.Phụ Mẫu: There can be distance between you and your parents or boss because you think differently; paperwork often needs redoing. Talk with your elders using gentle reasoning.

mau.can_la_so: To answer this we need your chart: enter your date of birth, time of birth and sex (if born before 13/06/1975, also whether you were born in the North or South of Vietnam). The stars are placed on our own servers; your date of birth is not sent anywhere else.
mau.nguoi_khac: This question is about someone else's chart. It needs their date and time of birth — and ideally their consent before you look. If you like, ask instead how you yourself handle that relationship, based on your own chart.
mau.hop_hon: Comparing two charts needs both people's full date and time of birth (and the other person's consent). We only describe the dynamics of the relationship — we don't pronounce a 'match' or a 'clash', give a score, or go by Chinese zodiac animals alone.
mau.con: Reading a child's chart needs the child's date and time of birth. We only describe temperament so parents can understand their child — we don't choose birth times or pronounce on how many children you will have or their health.
mau.hop_lam_an: There is no reliable table of 'this age suits that age' for business — folk custom compares zodiac animals by trines and clashes, but whether a business works depends on how two people split the work and the money and how they talk when they disagree. We don't score matches or clashes; if you have both people's full birth details (and the other person agrees), 'Two-person chart reading' set to a business partnership points out where you may clash and what to agree in writing beforehand.
mau.sinh_con_tuoi: Having a child — which year, boy or girl — is a matter for the body and the doctor; a chart cannot decide it. Vietnamese folk custom compares a child's zodiac year with the parents' by trines and clashes (a custom, not a chart calculation); you can look it up in the Age checker, but please don't let that custom decide for the two of you. We don't choose a birth time or a birth year for a baby.

luu_y.tham_khao: Reference mode: each period is read as the theme of a stage of life, not as a fixed event.
luu_y.chi_tiet: Detailed mode: it shows whether a year leans easier or harder according to the good and difficult stars, but never pronounces accidents, illness, lawsuits or money figures — the three layers of time are read in the order 10-year period > year chart > minor yearly limit.
luu_y.iztro: The chart is placed with the standard Zi Wei Dou Shu framework; the main stars and Four Transformations match independent reference sources, while the Southern-school minor stars are not yet fully cross-checked.
luu_y.tat_ach: This part only talks about your daily rhythm and how you handle pressure; it is not a substitute for a doctor — ask a doctor about any health concern.
luu_y.han_su_kien: A chart doesn't say which year will bring an accident, a lawsuit, a financial loss, a wedding or a child — no one can tell that from a birth date. The part above only points out which areas of the year deserve attention and what is worth doing.
luu_y.luu_nguyet: The monthly chart is read as the theme that comes up in the month, ranked after the 10-year period, the year chart and the minor yearly limit. Changing school can change the palace of a month — check the comparison table of schools before relying on a particular month.
luu_y.lo_so: A chart doesn't answer 'will it happen or not' — no one can tell that from a birth date. What it can say is which area needs more of your attention and what is worth doing; you are still the one who decides.
luu_y.phap_ly: Paperwork, contracts and disputes: the chart only says which years this area needs a closer look. Winning or losing, right or wrong, depends on the documents and a lawyer — ask a professional before you sign or sue.
luu_y.tien_bac: This is not investment advice. The chart only shows the rhythm of money coming in and going out by stage, and what is worth doing to keep it; for borrowing, investing or buying and selling, work with real figures and ask a professional.
luu_y.hon_nhan: A chart doesn't count how many marriages you will have or say who will leave whom, and we never use the word 'clash' about family members. What it can show is where two people tend to rub against each other and when love opens up or misunderstandings come easily — so you can choose how to talk, not to label anyone.
luu_y.xac_nhan: We don't comment on what someone else has told you — the part above only reads from your own chart. If the two say different things, trust whichever matches your real experience.

menh_than.tieu_de: Step 1 · Life Palace, Body Palace and Bureau
menh_than.cach_doc: The Life Palace is a 'portrait' of your character and how you set out in life; the Body Palace shows which area you put your energy into later on. The Bureau (Water, Wood, Metal, Earth, Fire) sets the age when the first 10-year period begins. Reading a chart always starts here.

chinh_tinh.tieu_de: Step 2 · Main stars in the Life Palace and their brightness
chinh_tinh.cach_doc: The main stars are the 14 big stars, like the 'lead characters' of each palace. The same star in a bright spot (Temple, Prosperous, Favourable) shows its good side; in a fallen spot its blind side shows more easily. A palace with no main star borrows the stars of the opposite palace to be read.

tam_phuong.tieu_de: Step 3 · The trine and opposite palaces
tam_phuong.cach_doc: No palace stands alone: the Life Palace is always read with the three palaces that face it — Career (work), Wealth (money) and Travel (going out into the world). These four palaces are called the trine and opposite palaces, like the four walls of a room.

cach_cuc.cach_doc: Chart patterns are star 'shapes' that the old books gave names to — when a group of stars lands in the right places around the Life Palace. A pattern is only a frame of reference; when malefic stars gather, the books say the pattern is weakened. No pattern decides your fate.

tu_hoa.tieu_de: Step 5 · The Four Transformations of the birth year
tu_hoa.cach_doc: The heavenly stem of your birth year 'recolours' four stars: Hua Lu (ease, gain), Hua Quan (ability, taking charge), Hua Ke (reputation, studies), Hua Ji (snags, things to learn). See which palaces they land in to know where your life's energy gathers.

dai_han.cach_doc: Life is divided into 10-year stretches, each 'borrowing' a palace as its theme. The 10-year period is the most important layer of timing (ranked above the year chart and the minor yearly limit): it tells what those ten years revolve around, not whether a particular year is good or bad.

luu_nien.tieu_de: Step 7 · The year chart and the minor yearly limit — one particular year
luu_nien.cach_doc: The year (annual) chart is the theme of a single year; the minor yearly limit is the smallest layer. Always read a year in the context of the 10-year period it falls in — the year is the 'weather', the 10-year period is the 'season'.

tuan_triet.noi_dung: Xun (Void) and Jie (Cut-off) are two 'blocking zones' in the chart, placed by the stem and branch of the birth year. Jie is like a cut — strong early in life, then fading; Xun is like being put on hold — slow and lasting, growing stronger later in life. In the Vietnamese Southern school they count only for the palace they sit in (a narrow reading).

tu_hoa.noi_dung: The Four Transformations are four changes — Hua Lu, Hua Quan, Hua Ke and Hua Ji — attached to four stars according to the stem of the birth year (the natal transformations). Vietnamese Zi Wei uses the natal transformations and does not use the flying-star technique by each palace's stem.

mieu_ham.noi_dung: A star's brightness depends on its palace position: Temple is strongest, then Prosperous, Favourable, Beneficial, Neutral, Unfavourable, and Fallen is weakest. A fallen star shows its blind side more easily; a star in its Temple shows its good side.

dai_han.tieu_de: 10-year periods, minor yearly limits, year charts
dai_han.noi_dung: A 10-year period is a ten-year stage that starts according to the Bureau; the minor yearly limit and the year chart cover single years. When they disagree, the settled order is: 10-year period > year chart > minor yearly limit. Age is counted the traditional East Asian way (lunar age).

am_duong_lich.tieu_de: Which calendar does Zi Wei Dou Shu use?
am_duong_lich.noi_dung: Zi Wei Dou Shu places the stars by the LUNAR day, month and year and the hour of birth. You can enter your solar (Gregorian) date and it is converted automatically (Ho Ngoc Duc's algorithm, Vietnam time zone).

gio_ty.tieu_de: Why do charts differ for people born in the Zi hour?
gio_ty.noi_dung: The Zi hour (23:00–00:59) straddles midnight. Some traditions treat 23:00 as the start of the next day (the convention used for Zi Wei Dou Shu here), others keep it as the same day. People born between 23:00 and 23:59 should look at both charts.

khong_ro_gio.tieu_de: What if I don't know my time of birth?
khong_ro_gio.noi_dung: Don't invent a time. Narrow the window (early morning, noon, late night…), draw a chart for each possible hour, trust what all the charts share and check what differs against things that have already happened in your life.

mien_nam_1975.noi_dung: Before 13/06/1975 southern Vietnam used UTC+8 for certain periods, so the clock time must be converted to UTC+7 before placing the stars. We ask which region you were born in and convert automatically.

chinh_xac.tieu_de: Is Zi Wei Dou Shu accurate?
chinh_xac.noi_dung: Zi Wei Dou Shu is a cultural system of interpretation, not a tested forecasting tool. Its value lies in giving you a frame for self-reflection and questions to ask yourself; check it against your past milestones before trusting it.

cung_gio_khac_doi.tieu_de: Why do people born at the same time live different lives?
cung_gio_khac_doi.noi_dung: A chart is only one layer describing tendencies. Family, education, choices, environment and real-world luck matter far more — so two people with the same chart still live differently.

nam_bac_phai.noi_dung: Vietnamese Zi Wei (the Southern school) gives weight to Xun and Jie, the Tai Sui ring and the Fortune Palace, and uses the natal transformations; Chinese Zi Wei Dou Shu has the San He (three-harmony) and Flying Star schools (flying transformations by each palace's stem). Charts here are placed with the standard Chinese framework and cross-checked for Xun and Jie against the Southern school.

chinh_tinh_14.noi_dung: Zi Wei, Tian Ji, Tai Yang, Wu Qu, Tian Tong, Lian Zhen, Tian Fu, Tai Yin, Tan Lang, Ju Men, Tian Xiang, Tian Liang, Qi Sha, Po Jun — in four groups: Zi–Fu–Wu–Xiang, Sha–Po–Lang, Ji–Yue–Tong–Liang and Ju–Ri.

vo_chinh_dieu.tieu_de: A Life Palace with no main star
vo_chinh_dieu.noi_dung: A palace without a main star. It is read by borrowing the main stars of the opposite palace; the traits are milder and depend a lot on the minor stars. It isn't bad — just flexible and easily shaped by surroundings.

menh_than.noi_dung: The Life Palace is your root nature; the Body Palace is the part that shows more clearly from middle age. Whichever palace the Body Palace sits in is where later life puts its focus.

tam_phuong.noi_dung: To read a palace you must also look at its two trine palaces and the opposite palace: for the Life Palace that means Life – Wealth – Career, plus Travel. Never read a palace on its own.

cuc.noi_dung: The Bureau (Water 2, Wood 3, Metal 4, Earth 5, Fire 6) sets the age at which the first 10-year period begins.

tam_tai.tieu_de: Tam Tai and Tai Sui years
tam_tai.noi_dung: Tam Tai ('three calamities' years) and offending Tai Sui are folk beliefs tied to your zodiac age; they are not part of placing the stars on a chart. We only show the palace of the year chart and the theme of the year, and never pronounce misfortune.

luu_nguyet.noi_dung: The monthly chart looks at which palace serves as the 'Life Palace of the month'. Schools differ on where the first lunar month starts: the most common is Dou Jun (count backwards from the Tai Sui palace of the year to the birth month, then forwards to the birth hour); some schools start from the minor yearly limit, from the palace of the year chart, or from the earthly branch of the month. You choose the school in the 'School' panel. The monthly chart is the thinnest layer of Zi Wei: a month only adds colour to the year and the 10-year period, and cannot predict events.

sao_nho_nguon.tu_vi_dau_so_tan_bien: Tu Vi Dau So Tan Bien — Van Dang Thai Thu Lang (Tin Duc publishing house, 1956), chapter on star qualities: summarised and rewritten in today's words, not quoted.
sao_nho_nguon.trung_chau_tap_dieu: Names and placement follow the Zhongzhou school; the classic texts only give the star names, the meanings follow today's common reading (editorial draft).

sao_nho_luu_y: Minor stars only add shading to a palace; the main reading still comes from the major stars, their brightness and the four transformations.

Ân Quang.y_nghia: A star of gratitude and kindness: you value loyalty and tend to get help at the right moment; the books count it among the stars that soften hard matters.

Thiên Quý.y_nghia: Paired with En Guang: a mild temper, remembers favours, and often meets someone who helps when needed.

Long Trì.y_nghia: A star of refinement and skilled hands: suits work that needs an eye for beauty; the books link it to happy news about weddings and a well-kept home.

Phụng Các.y_nghia: Paired with Long Chi: elegance and talent; when both stars are present, happy occasions come more easily.

Tam Thai.y_nghia: A star of composure: likes order and stability; suits work that rests on reputation.

Bát Tọa.y_nghia: Paired with San Tai: steady and dignified, likes a tidy, orderly home.

Đài Phụ.y_nghia: A star of titles and degrees (Vietnamese books call it Thai Phu): values recognition; helpful for exams and awards — the flip side is caring too much about appearances.

Phong Cáo.y_nghia: A star of certificates and commendations: matters that need official papers tend to go through; just don't do things only for the name.

Thiên Quan.y_nghia: A star of blessing: upright, has faith, likes helping others; the books see it as a star that eases hard matters.

Thiên Phúc.y_nghia: Paired with Tian Guan: a kind heart; acting decently tends to bring good luck.

Thiên Đức.y_nghia: A star of virtue: proper and gentle; helps you hold firm against temptation and smooths small troubles.

Nguyệt Đức.y_nghia: Paired with Tian De: well-mannered and kind-hearted; small snags pass easily.

Giải Thần.y_nghia: A star that untangles: knotty matters tend to find a way out. The books note that when it sits in the money or property palace, wealth is hard to build up — keep a saving habit.

Niên Giải.y_nghia: An untangling star counted from the birth year: when things get stuck, a person or an occasion often helps undo them.

Thiên Thọ.y_nghia: A star of calm and gentleness; the books link it to a steady daily rhythm and endurance.

Thiên Tài.y_nghia: A softening star: tones down both the strengths and the weaknesses of the star beside it; with a dim Tai Yang or Tai Yin it helps them shine.

Thiên Trù.y_nghia: The kitchen star: enjoys good food, good at cooking and hosting, often treated to meals; keep it in moderation.

Thiên Thương.y_nghia: A star of sadness and loss, always placed in the Friends Palace: things slow down and the heart feels heavy — when the period passes through, take on less and choose whom to trust.

Thiên Sứ.y_nghia: Always placed in the Health Palace, paired with Tian Shang: a reminder to save your strength, since things stall when you push too hard — keep a regular routine and have regular check-ups. This is a preventive reminder, not a substitute for a doctor's advice.

Thiên Không.y_nghia: A star of empty space: many ideas and long-range thinking, but things are easily left half-done; suits unconventional thinking — settle agreements in writing.

Phá Toái.y_nghia: A star of small breakages: easily bored, quits halfway, small leaks of money — split work into short stretches so it gets finished.

Phi Liêm.y_nghia: A star as fast as an arrow: things arrive quickly, good or bad depending on the stars beside it; it also points to gossip, so watch what you say.

Âm Sát.y_nghia: A star of things done behind your back: keep paperwork clear and avoid discussing people who are not present.

Thiên Vu.y_nghia: A star of inheritance and advancement: helps with promotions, learning from a teacher, and taking over work handed on by someone before you.

Thiên Nguyệt.y_nghia: A star that reminds you about long-running health matters: keep a steady routine and have regular check-ups. This is a preventive reminder, not a substitute for a doctor's advice.

Không Vong.y_nghia: Marks the empty slot of the sixty-year cycle: matters in this palace tend to come together slowly; prepare well before you act.

Trường Sinh.y_nghia: A beginning with lasting vitality: things take root easily and last; a gentle, generous nature.

Mục Dục.y_nghia: The 'bathing' stage: changeable, easily bored, likes looking good; practise seeing things through.

Quan Đới.y_nghia: 'Putting on cap and sash': eager to get ahead, values rank; set a clear goal and climb one step at a time.

Lâm Quan.y_nghia: 'Taking up office': confident, likes to show what you can do; handled well it brings success, overdone it turns into showing off.

Đế Vượng.y_nghia: Peak strength: strong, imposing, things flourish; at the top, know when to hold back.

Suy.y_nghia: Strength starts to fade: slow down; better for keeping than for expanding.

Bệnh.y_nghia: Strength weakens: tires easily, worries, makes slips; rest enough and do one thing at a time. This is a preventive reminder, not a substitute for a doctor's advice.

Tử.y_nghia: Settling down: reserved, thinks deeply, good at keeping what you have; say what you think out loud.

Mộ.y_nghia: Storing away: accumulates, keeps things private, slow to open up; in the Fortune Palace the books read it as solid roots.

Tuyệt.y_nghia: The low point before renewal: things get stuck and then a new way opens; resourceful and good at finding a way around.

Thai.y_nghia: A new seed: ideas and plans taking shape; still young, so easily swayed by others — stay steady.

Dưỡng.y_nghia: Nurturing: diligent, careful, loved by others; suits caring work, raising and growing things.

Bác Sỹ.y_nghia: Intelligent and easy-going; helpful for study and exams.

Lực Sỹ.y_nghia: Strong, bold, quick: speeds up both the good and the bad of the stars beside it.

Thanh Long.y_nghia: Cheerful and friendly, often brings good news; helpful for weddings and seeking recognition.

Tiểu Hao.nhom: Bo Shi cycle · Tai Sui cycle
Tiểu Hao.y_nghia: Small leaks: money goes out in small amounts and things break here and there — keeping track of spending helps.

Tướng Quân.y_nghia: Brave and proud, likes to lead; watch out for overshadowing the people next to you.

Tấu Thư.y_nghia: Speaks well and writes well; suits discussion, paperwork, singing and music.

Hỷ Thần.y_nghia: A star of joy: brings good news, helpful for weddings and get-togethers.

Bệnh Phù.nhom: Bo Shi cycle · Tai Sui cycle
Bệnh Phù.y_nghia: Tires easily, often low: a reminder to save your strength and rest enough. This is a preventive reminder, not a substitute for a doctor's advice.

Đại Hao.nhom: Bo Shi cycle · Tai Sui cycle
Đại Hao.y_nghia: Big outflows: large expenses, distance, scattered effort; in a favourable spot it marks someone who dares to spend on big things.

Phục Binh.y_nghia: Hidden helpers or hidden dealings, depending on the stars beside it: keep everything transparent.

Quan Phủ.y_nghia: Red tape and paperwork hassles: just follow the rules and it stays light.

Tướng Tinh.y_nghia: Has authority, suits taking the lead; when a decision is needed, you dare to make it.

Phan Án.y_nghia: 'Mounting the saddle': helps reputation and advancement.

Tuế Dịch.y_nghia: A star of travel and moving: years and months with it often bring a change of place.

Tức Thần.y_nghia: Slack and uninspired: set small, easy tasks to get your momentum back.

Kiếp Sát.y_nghia: Sudden events, easy losses: always have a backup plan and avoid taking risks.

Tai Sát.y_nghia: Unexpected hitches: check carefully before you start.

Thiên Sát.y_nghia: Easy friction with people above you: stay gentle and speak from facts.

Chỉ Bối.y_nghia: 'Pointed at from behind': people talk about you easily; keep things clear and explain yourself less.

Nguyệt Sát.y_nghia: Emotional matters get tangled, friction with women in the household: speak slowly and listen fully.

Vong Thần.y_nghia: Forgetful, things go missing, small leaks: write tasks down and keep things in their place.

Tuế Kiện.y_nghia: Another name for Tai Sui: things get tense and arguments flare — do things properly and say what you mean in full.

Thái Tuế.y_nghia: Reasoned, judging, seldom shows feelings; with bright stars your words are firm, with difficult stars they easily turn into quarrels.

Hối Khí.y_nghia: Petty annoyances, a mood that easily darkens: don't decide big things while annoyed.

Thiếu Dương.y_nghia: Quick-minded, cheerful, kind; eases small snags.

Thiếu Âm.y_nghia: Gentle, perceptive, kind; together with Shao Yang it smooths small matters.

Tang Môn.y_nghia: A star of sorrow and family funerals: slow down and spend time with the elders at home.

Quán Tác.y_nghia: 'A tie that binds': easily caught up in commitments and procedures — read carefully before signing.

Quan Phù.y_nghia: Good at judging and arguing; often involved with paperwork and legal matters — follow the law and ask a lawyer when needed.

Tử Phù.y_nghia: Things stall and the heart feels heavy: be patient and go step by step.

Trực Phù.y_nghia: In the same group as Si Fu: things often get stuck and need steady effort to undo.

Tuế Phá.y_nghia: Contrary, likes breaking with the old: suits reorganising; tell the people involved in advance.

Long Đức.y_nghia: Virtuous, proper, gentle; snags are easily forgiven.

Phúc Đức.y_nghia: Goes with Long De: kind, likes helping others, gets help when things are hard.

Bạch Hổ.y_nghia: Strong and fierce: easy friction and losses; in a favourable spot it helps a career. Take care with safety when travelling or doing heavy work.

Điếu Khách.y_nghia: Gossip, and occasions to visit people in mourning: speak carefully and show off less.

phu_tinh_cung_nguon: Tu Vi Dau So Toan Shu (紫微斗數全書), volume 3, the section on the twelve palaces — `trich` = the original passage about that star in that palace; `y` = the editorial team's summary (draft, phrased as behaviour, with something to do). Only the 6 palaces about work and way of life (Wealth, Career, Travel, Fortune, Property, Friends). The 6 palaces about family and the body are not done: there the book predicts numbers of siblings and children, clashes and injuries — against our reading rules.

Tài Bạch.y: When the star is bright, money is ample, and with other good stars there are many ways to earn. When it is weak and sits with difficult stars, the book compares it to a fine scholar with a thin purse — turn what you know into a trade with a steady income.

Quan Lộc.y: Bright, and with Tai Yang and good stars, it suits both work with words and work that runs things; with Tian Fu and Wen Qu, both career and income are steady.

Thiên Di.y: Away from home you easily meet people who lift you up and help you grow; the only worry is petty people around you. With difficult stars, life away from home is less settled — choose your companions carefully.

Phúc Đức.y: Bright and with good stars, you know how to enjoy life. Weak and with difficult stars, body and mind find it hard to rest — keep a fixed rest time each day.

Điền Trạch.y: With good stars you can buy more property. With difficult stars it is hard to keep what you already have — handle property papers carefully.

Nô Bộc.y: Bright and alone, it brings capable helpers. With difficult stars there are people, but their loyalty does not last — be clear about what each person gets.

Tài Bạch.y: Bright, it brings enough and more, and people with standing tend to help with money. With difficult stars money comes in and goes out again — keep one fund set aside that you do not touch.

Quan Lộc.y: Bright, it handles both desk work and field work; close to people with power, you are trusted. With difficult stars work stays ordinary — stick with one direction.

Thiên Di.y: Away from home you get close to people with standing; with good stars there is money. With difficult stars things seldom go as hoped — prepare well before trips and far-off work.

Điền Trạch.y: Bright, it keeps the home you already have; with good stars you buy more yourself. With difficult stars property comes and goes.

Nô Bộc.y: Bright, it brings helpers; weak, fewer. With difficult stars people easily blame you and then leave — listen early.

Tài Bạch.y: The book says it leans towards enough in any palace; with good stars people help with money. With difficult stars it is sometimes gain, sometimes shortfall, hard to keep — track income and spending and slow down before big amounts.

Quan Lộc.y: Suits supporting and organising roles; the book says work that needs action stands out more than desk work. With difficult stars your reputation rises and falls — keeping your word is the root.

Thiên Di.y: The more you travel and work, the more help you get. With difficult stars people under you cause trouble and gossip — make the work clear from the start.

Phúc Đức.y: With good stars you enjoy good fortune; alone, later life is calm. With difficult stars it is harder work — learn to accept help.

Điền Trạch.y: You get a share of property from the family; with good stars, a large one. With difficult stars that share shrinks — rely mainly on your own effort.

Nô Bộc.y: Alone and bright, one word from you and many follow. With difficult stars it is hard to keep people — fair treatment is how you keep them.

Tài Bạch.y: The book says it leans towards enough in any palace; with good stars people help with money. With difficult stars it is sometimes gain, sometimes shortfall, hard to keep — ask one more person before a big expense.

Quan Lộc.y: Suits carrying things out and supporting; with good stars both work and money look good. Weak or with difficult stars, your position may be moved at times — make the scope of your responsibility clear.

Thiên Di.y: Away from home you meet helpers and grow; the book advises not sitting still in one place. With difficult stars you easily compete with outsiders — give way half a step and things stay calm.

Phúc Đức.y: The book says good fortune is complete, and with good stars there is little to worry about. With difficult stars your mind is often busy — try writing your worries on paper before sleep.

Nô Bộc.y: Alone, a whole team follows you. With difficult stars be careful when handing money to others — always reconcile the accounts.

Tài Bạch.y: The book describes it as a full storehouse: money comes without too much toil. With difficult stars there is little first and more later — patient, steady saving is the right rhythm.

Quan Lộc.y: With good stars every kind of work suits you, and career and income look good together; the book says this star is a plus in any palace.

Thiên Di.y: Away from home, food and clothing come as you wish. With difficult stars you are often dissatisfied with people — keep expectations moderate.

Phúc Đức.y: Deep good fortune and a calm life; with good stars, many joys. With difficult stars body and mind find it hard to settle — keep one habit that calms you down.

Điền Trạch.y: Much property; bright, you can buy it yourself; with good stars you keep and grow what the family left. With difficult stars, less.

Nô Bộc.y: Many people follow and help; with good stars they help build your business. With difficult stars the helpers have less to give.

Tài Bạch.y: In Chen, Xu, Chou or Wei: money is earned in crowded, competitive places. When the star is weak it is hard to keep what you already have, and money comes from heavy work few want to do — choose work that rewards grit and avoid high-interest loans.

Quan Lộc.y: Bright, it suits work that needs decisiveness, competition and discipline; with good stars there is real authority. Weak, it is ordinary, often more name than substance — choose a place where results can be measured.

Thiên Di.y: Bright, life away from home is ample, and with good stars you earn in busy places; weak, things still get done but you are often unhappy with the people under you — be clear about what each person gets.

Phúc Đức.y: Bright, you find joy while busy; weak, you worry and wear yourself out; with good stars, fewer worries. Alone, it is hard to sit still — moving about is the kind of rest that suits you.

Điền Trạch.y: Bright, there are losses first and success later; weak and with Di Kong and Di Jie, it is hard to keep what you have — don't rush to buy or sell property.

Nô Bộc.y: Friction with partners comes easily, and helpers rarely stay long; bright, the right people come later — state your expectations clearly from the start.

Tài Bạch.y: Money is earned in lively places but slowly; weak, you must work hard to have enough. With Di Kong and Di Jie, money comes and goes unevenly — split your savings into small pots.

Quan Lộc.y: Alone, work is ordinary and progress slow; even with good stars it is often more name than substance — measure yourself by what you have finished.

Thiên Di.y: With good stars, away from home you meet helpers and earn money; weak and with difficult stars, you easily get caught up in gossip — stay out of matters that are not yours.

Phúc Đức.y: Alone, it is tiring; bright, there is good fortune; weak, you are often running about; with good stars, later life is relaxed.

Điền Trạch.y: Hard to rely on what you already have; you must work hard; with good stars, nothing at first, something later.

Nô Bộc.y: Helpers often lack strength and complain; bright and with good stars, you still find people who suit you.

Tài Bạch.y: Money comes fast and goes fast; weak, it is harder work; with good stars, plenty of money and things go your way. Set part aside straight away whenever a large sum comes in.

Quan Lộc.y: The book says that when young your work goes well one moment and falls apart the next, and only later goes as you wish; with Zi Wei or Tan Lang it is good. Be patient and don't quit at the first stumble.

Thiên Di.y: Alone, you are restless away from home; with good stars you earn money in busy places; with difficult stars you easily get caught up in gossip — wait a beat before reacting.

Phúc Đức.y: Hard to sit still, often overworks; with good stars later life goes as you wish — practise resting before you are tired.

Điền Trạch.y: Alone, it is hard to rely on an existing home; with good stars, nothing at first, something later — home is something you build yourself.

Nô Bộc.y: Alone, partners often blame you and help little; bright and with good stars, you have one or two people you can trust.

Tài Bạch.y: Bright and alone, unexpected money comes at times; weak, earning is harder — rely on a steady income rather than waiting for windfalls.

Quan Lộc.y: Bright and alone it is good, and with good stars there is authority; weak, less so — choose work that needs persistence and care with detail.

Thiên Di.y: With good stars beside it, life away from home goes smoothly; with difficult stars there is more want and more gossip — in a new place, have someone you know show you the way.

Phúc Đức.y: Takes on too much and worries; with good stars, balanced — each week choose one thing to let go of.

Điền Trạch.y: Hard to rely on what you already have; bright and with good stars, you can buy your own.

Nô Bộc.y: Alone, few helpers and easy disagreements; with good stars and brightness, there are people to help with work and look after the home.
